Procedures & Functions
Sub Procedure: • Performs actions without returning a value. • Syntax: Sub ProcedureName(parameters) ' statements End Sub • Call: ProcedureName(arguments) Function Procedure: • Calculates and returns a single value. • Requires Return statement and return type. • Syntax: Function Name(params) As DataType Return value End Function • Call: result = Name(arguments) Parameters (ByVal vs ByRef): • ByVal: Passes a copy (original unchanged). • ByRef: Passes memory reference (modifies original).
